title: A Well for the Smile
author: Beatrix Oyelaran
blurb: Ulyana Okonkwo, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the last resident signs the papers.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
